lethal_volumes.message: Outside the stakes the flat is not flat. The mud takes you.

happening.text: The delve opens on the barrow flat at the night's first low water.

happening.subject: anchor/wake
happening.text: The party comes up out of the flat at the first ebb with a passage-token in hand.

objectives.hint: You are face-down on the Barrow Flat at the night's first ebb, with a lead passage-token shut in your fist. Get your feet under you.
objectives.title: Stand Up

happening.text: The delve teaches its first rule: this rock marks the ground that kills you, and the marking is always there to be read.

happening.subject: anchor/stake-2
happening.text: The party learns the flat has an edge: inside the three iron stakes is walking, outside it the mud takes them.

objectives.hint: Three rusted iron stakes stand in a line across the flat. Inside them is walking. Outside them the cairns are thickest, and so is the mud.
objectives.title: Walk the Stake Line

happening.text: The party is told what the bell says, and therefore what a wrong number would have meant.

happening.subject: npc/emeric-tallow
happening.text: Emeric Tallow gives the party the three tolls: one is a body coming across, two is the way is shut, three is the way is open.

objectives.hint: An old man has a shore-lamp lit on the last dry shelf where the flat meets the cliff. He has lit one every night for fifty-one years. Ask him about the bell.
objectives.title: Speak to the Lampman

npc/emeric-tallow.doing: Keeping the lamp on the shelf below and not following the climb — he has not been past the gate in fifty-one years and is not starting now.

happening.text: The party climbs the seaward face and crosses the section of road the sea has already taken.

happening.subject: anchor/shore-foot
happening.text: The party leaves the flat for the cut ledge on the seaward face.

objectives.hint: The flat ends at a wall of cliff and one cut ledge starts up it. There is no other way on.
objectives.title: Start Up the Cut Ledge

happening.subject: anchor/gap-brink
happening.text: The party learns the road is read off the wall: where the brackets fail, the shelf is already in the sea.

objectives.hint: A line of iron brackets runs along the wall at hand height. Where they bend down or stop, the shelf under them has already gone into the sea. Read the wall, not the floor.
objectives.title: Cross the Fallen Section

happening.text: The rope leaves the cliff store in the party's hands and does not leave them again until the tower.

happening.subject: item/mooring-line
happening.text: The party takes the priory's mooring line out of the cliff store — the first of the delve's two carried objects.

objectives.hint: The road goes through the rock: a store cut into the face where the priory kept the handrail it stopped replacing. The coil inside is salt-hard and it is the rope the bell will need.
objectives.title: Take the Rope

happening.text: The party is inside the rock, on the wrong side of its front door.

happening.subject: anchor/breach
happening.text: The party enters Halgrave through the priory's own broken wall and comes down inside the gate passage.

objectives.hint: The road does not reach the gate. It reaches a hole the sea broke in the gatehouse's outer wall, and puts you inside the gate passage behind a portcullis that is shut against the shore you woke on.
objectives.title: Enter Halgrave

happening.text: Halgrave's front door is opened from behind it, by somebody the priory would never have opened it for.

happening.subject: anchor/winch
happening.text: The party works the gate winch and raises the portcullis from the inside.

objectives.hint: The winch is on the passage's inner side, where a porter would stand. Raising the grate opens the rock's front door from behind it.
objectives.title: Work the Winch

obj/work-the-winch.text: The winch takes both hands and half a minute. The grate comes up out of the flags a tooth at a time, and through it the flat you crossed an hour ago lies open all the way back to the water.

npc/emeric-tallow.doing: Tending the shore-lamp alone at the foot of the rock, listening to the climb happen somewhere above him.

happening.text: The party crosses the drowned outer ward without leaving the one raised line across it.

happening.subject: anchor/causeway-head
happening.text: The party takes the raised spine out over the drowned ward.

objectives.hint: The outer ward's floor has been under the sea for fifty-one years. A raised stone spine crosses it to the water-gate tower, above the water, visible end to end from where you stand.
objectives.title: Take the Causeway

happening.subject: anchor/weed-pinch-2
happening.text: The party learns that on the causeway the ground is the danger and the waders are only what makes it matter.

objectives.hint: Heaped weed fouls the spine at two points and makes you slow down at exactly the reach of the things standing in the water. Position is the whole of this ward.
objectives.title: Get Past the Weed

happening.text: The party gets into a tower that would not open to them, by not using its door.

happening.subject: anchor/arcade-walk
happening.text: The party leaves the causeway for the arcade top, the tower's shuttered storey being the only way in.

objectives.hint: The tower's ground door is barred from the inside. The ruined arcade beside it stands level with the tower's mid-storey, and its top is walkable.
objectives.title: Climb the Arcade

happening.subject: anchor/tower-upper
happening.text: The party enters the water-gate tower at shutter height.

objectives.hint: The shutter is at arcade height. Go in through it.
objectives.title: Enter at Shutter Height

happening.text: A door that answered the party from the wrong side is opened from the right one.

happening.subject: anchor/barred-door
happening.text: The party comes down inside the water-gate tower and takes the bar off its ground door.

objectives.hint: Descend inside the tower to its ground floor and lift the bar off the door that told you, from the far side, that it did not open from there.
objectives.title: Go Down Inside

on_complete.text: The bar comes off and the door swings out over the causeway you have just finished walking. From here on it opens from either side.

npc/sister-ide.doing: Walking her round straight through the Sextons' fight without breaking step, and not thanking anybody for ending it.

happening.text: The party crosses into the roofless chapel ward and finds the first fight it has room to lose.

happening.subject: anchor/ward
happening.text: The party crosses into the roofless chapel ward.

objectives.hint: The ward is a cloister with its roof gone, arcade on all four sides and sky above it. After two enclosed zones the space itself is the event.
objectives.title: Cross into the Cloister

happening.subject: wave/the-two-sextons
happening.text: The Two Sextons are put down in the middle of their own round, still working in step.

objectives.hint: They carried the dead in from the boats and they still work as a pair. They arrive together and they will not let you take them one at a time. The cloister piers are the answer.
objectives.title: Put Down the Two Sextons

happening.subject: wave/the-two-sextons
happening.text: The Two Sextons come across the ward together, in step, the way they always carried.

obj/into-the-cloister.text: Sister Ide walks her round through the middle of it with a cracked hand-bell and does not look up. Two of them come across the paving together, in step.

npc/sister-ide.doing: Back on her round in the roofless cloister, counting the hours down toward a tide she has been counting toward for fifty-one years.

happening.text: The delve's clearest shortcut is opened, and the route it replaces stops being necessary.

happening.subject: anchor/lamp-step
happening.text: The party unbars the chapel's banded door and opens the way back down to the gatehouse yard.

objectives.hint: The one intact door on the rock is on the chapel side of the ward: oak, iron-banded, a ring handle, barred from where you are standing.
objectives.title: Unbar the Banded Door

npc/ancel-wray.doing: Not moving while his guard captain is beaten on the floor of his own hall, because he has never moved for anything.

happening.text: The party reaches the one building on Halgrave with its roof still on, and it is worse than the ruins.

happening.subject: anchor/hall-door
happening.text: The party enters the one building on Halgrave the sea has never been in.

objectives.hint: Roof on, floor swept, dust standing in the light. It is the first place in the delve that is not a ruin, and that is worse.
objectives.title: Enter the Hall

happening.subject: wave/housecarl-ridd
happening.text: Housecarl Ridd is beaten on the open floor of the hall he was posted to keep.

objectives.hint: Ancel's guard captain, armoured, living, alone, and the first opponent in this delve who blocks and waits. He is the man who broke the belfry stair, and he is not sorry.
objectives.title: Beat Housecarl Ridd

happening.subject: wave/housecarl-ridd
happening.text: Housecarl Ridd comes off his post and takes the floor of the hall he was left to keep.

obj/into-the-hall.text: A voice down the length of the hall, flat and unhurried. "He said nobody goes up. Nobody has gone up."

npc/ancel-wray.doing: Answering for the two tolls to the first person in fifty-one years who has come far enough to ask.

npc/emeric-tallow.doing: Tending the shore-lamp alone at the foot of the rock, listening to the climb happen somewhere above him.

happening.text: The party is handed the last two facts of the delve by the man who made them dangerous.

happening.subject: npc/ancel-wray
happening.text: Ancel Wray gives up the two facts the climb needs: the tongue went down the cistern well, and the belfry stair is broken at the first flight.

objectives.hint: He is in his chair and he has not left it. He is not a fight, in any branch. He will answer for the two tolls and he does not think he was wrong.
objectives.title: Speak to Prior Ancel Wray

on_complete.text: He gives up both facts without a flicker, because in fifty-one years neither has ever been worth anything to anybody. He does not know what the tide is doing tonight.

npc/ancel-wray.doing: Sitting the chair, finished with his part of it, waiting to learn whether the number he chose is going to be corrected.

npc/emeric-tallow.doing: Holding the lamp on the shelf at the lowest water in fifty-one years, waiting to hear whether the bell says anything at all.

npc/hask.doing: Keeping well back from the well head and the man standing at it, and watching to see which of them is left.

npc/odo-ferrier.doing: Standing the stairhead below the belfry floor, one flight short of the rope, as he has at every low water for fifty-one years.

npc/sister-ide.doing: Ringing the hours over an empty ward while the sea goes out below her, further than she has ever had to count.

happening.text: The climb's last move is a descent, and it ends at the well the tongue went down.

happening.subject: anchor/duct
happening.text: The party leaves the last dry room on the rock and goes down under it.

objectives.hint: The way on from the hall is down: a service duct out of the keep, under everything you have already crossed.
objectives.title: Take the Keep Stair Down

happening.subject: anchor/well
happening.text: The party reaches the well head at the deep end of the cistern.

objectives.hint: A brick barrel vault under the rock, standing ankle-deep, ranked on piers, lit by one hole. The well is at the deep end, and there is a man standing in front of it.
objectives.title: Reach the Well Head

happening.subject: wave/the-founder
happening.text: The Founder takes his place between the well head and everything else in the cistern.

obj/enter-the-descent.text: The duct puts you out three courses above a brick floor and the drop is the way in. Somewhere ahead a lamp is burning on the fallen vault, and the light lies flat on the water all the way to the piers.

happening.text: The party and the man in front of it want the same object for opposite reasons, and only one of them leaves the well.

happening.subject: wave/the-founder
happening.text: The Founder goes down beside the well he threw the tongue into, in the water he has stood in since.

objectives.hint: He cast Mercy, he was made to strike out its tongue, he threw it down this well and he came down after it. He is comfortable in this water and he never says anything.
objectives.title: Put Down the Founder

happening.text: The thing the whole night exists for is picked up off a floor nobody has stood on for fifty-one years.

happening.subject: item/the-tongue
happening.text: The party lifts Mercy's tongue out of the well bed — the second and last carried object of the delve.

objectives.hint: Copper, the length of a man, lying in silt that has not seen air since the year it was thrown here. It is not a reward and it is not unlocked. It is uncovered.
objectives.title: Take the Bell's Tongue

happening.text: The delve's longest walk back is turned into twenty seconds by a grate that only opens from the wrong side.

happening.subject: anchor/grille
happening.text: The party breaks the cistern grate outward and opens the only route up out of the deep.

objectives.hint: An iron grate is set in a broken wall on the cistern's far side, openable only from here. It is the only route back up.
objectives.title: Break the Grate Outward

happening.subject: anchor/breach
happening.text: The party comes out of the rock onto the outer ward's own floor.

objectives.hint: Through the hole and out onto the drowned ward, on a floor nobody has stood on since before you died.
objectives.title: Come Out on the Ward

happening.text: The tower stops being the thing above the player and becomes the thing in front of them.

happening.subject: anchor/ramp-head
happening.text: The party comes up the ramp of the upper ward and sees the whole climb as one shape for the first time.

objectives.hint: A cobbled ramp steps up between the collapsed low buildings of the upper ward, with the tower standing at the head of it.
objectives.title: Climb the Upper Ward

happening.subject: anchor/tower-foot
happening.text: The party reaches the foot of the bell tower.

objectives.hint: In at the small arched door at the base of the tower.
objectives.title: Reach the Tower Foot

happening.text: The one thing the household did to the tower is undone with the one thing the priory left on the cliff.

happening.subject: anchor/tread-stand
happening.text: The party lays the two missing tread courses at the head of the broken flight and opens the whole tower above it.

objectives.hint: The household broke the first flight so that nobody would go up. What is left climbs four courses and stops three short of the landing. Two tread courses close it, and the rope from the cliff road is what lays them.
objectives.missing_item_hint: You need both hands and something to lash with. The priory's mooring line is in the store cut into the cliff road, and the road goes straight through it.
objectives.title: Lay the Missing Treads

on_complete.text: Far above you, boots on stone, coming down. He is not waiting at the top any more.

happening.subject: npc/odo-ferrier
happening.text: Odo Ferrier comes off the stairhead and puts himself in the way.

happening.subject: wave/odo-ferrier
happening.text: The first of the answered takes the stairhead below the belfry floor.

obj/lay-the-treads.text: Both courses or neither. The line goes round the bracket, the second tread beds down on the first, and the switchback above you joins up for the first time since the night it was cut.

happening.text: The delve's thesis arrives as a fight: he wants what the party wants, he was wronged the same way, and he is on the stair.

happening.subject: wave/odo-ferrier
happening.text: Odo Ferrier is beaten off the stairhead and stops being in the way.

objectives.hint: He rowed the dead out of Halgrave for thirty years and the living off the flat until the boat went over, and he means to be the last hand himself. He does not want to kill you and says so between the swings. The broken flight is behind you.
objectives.title: Get Past Odo Ferrier

happening.subject: npc/odo-ferrier
happening.text: Odo comes back onto the stairhead beaten and sits down on the stair. He does not die and he cannot be finished.

obj/put-odo-off-the-stair.text: He goes down on the tread and stays there, and the arm he was swinging with comes to rest across his knees. "...Then go up. Ring it properly. If you can only do one thing right tonight, do the number right."

npc/ancel-wray.doing: Sitting the chair, finished with his part of it, waiting to learn whether the number he chose is going to be corrected.

npc/emeric-tallow.doing: Holding the lamp on the shelf at the lowest water in fifty-one years, waiting to hear whether the bell says anything at all.

npc/hask.doing: Waiting at the cistern wall for a road that is dry and empty at the same time, which is a thing only the bell can give him.

npc/odo-ferrier.doing: Sitting on the stair where he was put down, out of the way at last, watching the last hand do what his never could.

npc/sister-ide.doing: Ringing the hours over an empty ward while the sea goes out below her, further than she has ever had to count.

happening.text: The bell can speak, and the last hand on the rope is the party's.

happening.subject: item/the-tongue
happening.text: Mercy gets its tongue back, fifty-one years after it was struck out.

objectives.hint: Mercy fills the belfry and the belfry is a room you walk around it in. Stand under the mouth and hang the tongue in the crown.
objectives.missing_item_hint: The tongue is still in the well bed in the cistern, where the sea uncovered it. It has to be carried up.
objectives.title: Hang the Tongue

happening.subject: anchor/bell-walk
happening.text: The rope is bent on at the frame and Mercy can be rung by a hand standing in the belfry.

objectives.hint: The rope from the cliff road bends on at the frame. Ringing this bell is a haul, at the scale of the thing being moved.
objectives.missing_item_hint: The priory's mooring line is what bends on here. It is in the store cut into the cliff road.
objectives.title: Bend On the Rope

on_complete.text: Three. The rope comes down and Mercy answers eleven miles inland with a number that has been owed on this coast since the night it was not given.

happening.text: THE WAY IS OPEN: three tolls at the lowest water in fifty-one years, and the debt is paid in the only currency it was ever owed in.

effects.text: The lamp on the fallen vault lays a flat sheet of light across the water, bay after bay, all the way to the piers — and one band of it, two blocks wide, gives nothing back at all. The floor is ankle-deep everywhere except where it is not.
